phase: L4 LANDED. The PRD is in the tree and L5 is UNBLOCKED. Fourteen outcomes, 13 of them EXERCISED bars -- no cell may claim an EXERCISED outcome REALIZED on the strength of its own artifact. THE ROOT SURFACE IS S12, THE IDENTITY LAYER, and it is NOT in the brief's own surface list: four surfaces depend on it (the coverage reader S4, the peer set S8, the social feed S13, the list register S15) and it is the direct remedy for the only defect this project has MEASURED IN PRODUCTION -- 48 of 54 existing packs carrying another company's peer set. Cutting S4, S8 or S13 before S12 rebuilds that defect on a new axis. S13's verb is 'measure, then build' because its substrate is a catalogue nobody has exercised.
blocking: NOTHING BLOCKS THIS PROJECT. L5 is 2.0.0_SA_COO~ZZZ's and is cuttable now. CARRIED FACTS THE CUT MUST NOT LOSE: (1) NO QUALIFICATION THRESHOLD EXISTS ANYWHERE AND NONE MAY BE INVENTED AT L5 -- L1 refused because a number invented early is treated as ratified by every later stage, and L4 refused for a different reason: the estate has not measured the distributions any threshold would be drawn against, and an unmeasured exact constant fails closed while looking principled. Each class's cell PRODUCES the measurement its threshold is drawn from and states the threshold in its own deliverable. (2) THREE MEASURED LANDMINES, none of which announces itself at run time and all of which produce a page that looks right: C-UNIT-MAP-MEASURED (a mnemonic-only field map is wrong by 100x in some cells and 1e6 in others), C-FISCAL-YEAR-JOIN (joining price to fundamentals on the date string DROPS 40% of the history), C-BLOOMBERG-BASIS (no mnemonic reproduces the vendor's normalized EPS -- adopt and STATE the basis, never reverse-engineer a lookalike). (3) C-VENDOR-EGRESS: NEVER call an external vendor API without Andrew's explicit per-use word. Availability is not authorization. A CELL MAY NOT SPEND THAT WORD AND MAY NOT ASSUME IT. (4) C-LISTING-NOT-CAPABILITY: nothing about the social datasets has been EXERCISED -- 1,763 listed and reachable, none triggered, no record returned, no cost, schema, latency or freshness observed, and whether they can be queried by cashtag at all is unknown. An acceptance criterion demanding a working feed from an unexercised catalogue is a criterion a correct build cannot satisfy. (5) THE MACRO RULING DOES NOT MOVE THE PROJECT BOUNDARY: AMGT (the macro) holds all of D5's research including the alt-research corpus, AND AMGT_RESAPP still 'does not consume or replace it' -- different axes, both true. If a cell would have this project absorb the transcript corpus or the 63-name materiality queue, that is a NEW scope question requiring Andrew's word. (6) EVERY F-NUMBERED MEASUREMENT IN THE BRIEF IS THE CRO'S AND HAS BEEN RE-DERIVED BY NOBODY, including the 48-of-54 figure S8 and S12 both lean on -- carried as CITED, not CONFIRMED; a cell relying on one re-measures it first. (7) C-DESIGN-SPEC-FIRST: no .tsx until the design spec is approved. (8) C-NO-CONTACT: no seat contacts Adam Muller; requirements reach him through Andrew and no other route.
